subject.title: fix: harden cloud worker admission and remote turns

question: Should this PR wait until Crabbox v0.38.1 is verified through all supported installation channels before OpenClaw requires its inspection metadata for AWS workers?
rationale: The implementation is correct and well-proven, but only the responsible release owner can coordinate the cross-repository rollout and intentionally accept or avoid temporary AWS worker unavailability.

options.title: Verify dependency rollout first
options.body: Publish and smoke-test Crabbox v0.38.1 through supported channels, refresh this PR against current main, and merge after the minimum-version contract is operational.

options.title: Accept a temporary outage
options.body: Merge now and intentionally accept that AWS worker profiles using older supported-channel Crabbox binaries will stop provisioning until operators upgrade.

recommendation.title: Verify dependency rollout first
recommendation.body: Publish and smoke-test Crabbox v0.38.1 through supported channels, refresh this PR against current main, and merge after the minimum-version contract is operational.

likelyOwner.reason: The history connects this person to both the OpenClaw cloud-worker series and the companion Crabbox release required for landing.
